rv.q: Stoker Wilde is clearly a labour of love, and has all the ingredients to be a hit...
This narrative is a good idea for a musical and the piece definitely has potential but before that is realised, a great deal more work will be needed.

cn.t: This developmental musical exploring the Stoker-Wilde friendship shows promise in its early stages, though critics view it as a work-in-progress with potential still to be realized.
